.guardian","weight":1.5,"affix":"allow","reason":"金壳封压允许主人以护甲保护准备位置，不把护甲写成剑器命。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.spirit-ward","weight":1.1,"affix":"allow","reason":"长准备需要抵挡术法压力，灵抗作用于施用者本人。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.hit-recovery","weight":1.8,"affix":"allow","reason":"主人受击后的恢复直接影响重新建立压力释放动作。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cast-mobility","weight":1.2,"affix":"allow","reason":"封压起手时减轻本人移速惩罚，便于预测出口方向。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.clear-water","weight":1,"affix":"allow","reason":"水膜封压方向可选择主人抗水减速，以稳定释放站位。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.blade-integrity","weight":2,"affix":"allow","reason":"封壳承压需要剑体余量，固刃增加本剑器命而非主人生命。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.tempered","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"汽焰锁的压力释放读取法攻，不由金属封壳改成物理系数。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.vital","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"封压承受的是剑体消耗，主人气血上限不作为压力容积。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cloud-step","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"汽焰锁培养预测与持压，随机池不再扩展主人高速游走路线。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.canopy","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"封压是本剑结构职责，不额外变成护卫附近全部单位的光环剑。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.water-mending","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"水膜随汽裂消费，汽焰锁的水路不是滋养治疗。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.physical-speed","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"御器封压不消费手持近战动作速度。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.spell-speed","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"法伤压力剑仍走御器动作，速诀不能缩短其准备流程。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.wood-flat","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"汽焰锁自行铺膜封压但没有木薪段，木点伤不属于这套火水金锁链。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.wood-increased","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"封压需要水膜与金壳，木百分比没有对应侧伤，不能冒作供薪效率。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.earth-flat","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"汽焰锁的封口来自金行，不是土行炉壳，土点伤不因“锁”字自动获准。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.earth-increased","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"本剑没有土侧伤或土镇压，土百分比不能提高封压容量。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.windborne","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"御风旧词已停用；汽焰锁仍保留长准备与原有飞行，不恢复旧航速捷径。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.far-seeking","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"寻远旧词不重新启用，预测封口仍须在现有可达距离内完成。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.mountain","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"镇岳旧词已停用；汽焰锁用水膜汽裂兑现压力，不把旧击退当成封压本体。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.resonant","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"共鸣旧词停用；完整汽裂锁链不等于可无限扩大命中范围。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.enduring","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"绵长旧词停用；留下的雷痕与灼痕按各自时长处理，不额外恢复旧持续词。"}]},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s24/effects/attacks/atlas-s24.continuous-returning-strike/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s24/weapon.pack.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts","src/combat/returning-sword-resources.ts","src/weapon-arsenal/core-growth.ts"],"legacyNodeIds":["binding:atlas-s24:attack"]},"designNotes":["本剑能在同次接触中先铺膜再破膜，仍需真实命中并支付准备与器气。","破膜后留下的是雷痕和灼痕，原水膜已经被消费。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s24","effects","attacks"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s24","name":"汽焰锁"}}}}
